summary: No functional discrepancies found. All 4 scenarios migrated with full control coverage; every primary action is behaviourally wired and produces the correct no-sensor response matching the UWP source.

measurementCaveats.detail: The original UWP app launched and rendered (scenario-1 golden captured at parity/baseline/screenshots/01_Data_Events.png). Per-scenario UWP navigation and control actuation could NOT be driven live: winapp's UIA tree for the UWP CoreWindow exposes only a top-level Pane (no child elements), and OS-level mouse injection is unavailable in this session (SetCursorPos clamps to 0,0, GetForegroundWindow returns 0). UWP scenarios 2-4 were therefore compared via source + WinUI UIA content rather than live UWP frames.

The migrated WinUI 3 window renders logically (full UIA tree with all controls, text and state is accessible) but pixel screenshots come back blank/white (~13 KB) because the WinUI 3 Win32 content is not composited to a capturable surface on this headless desktop. Visual judgement therefore relies on the per-scenario UIA dumps (parity/winui3/ui/*.json) and observed control text/state, not on WinUI pixels. This is an environment limitation, not a migration defect.
